text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Were you watching? Did you see how I
sprinted
across the finish line in first
place?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course! There's no way I'd let
someone like
Vodka get the best of me!
choice_data_list: An incredible run, just as I'd expect!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not letting up! I'm going to get
first in the
next race as well!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The first hurdle of the Triple Tiara?
Hmph! I'll leap
right over it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All right, no time to rest. This is just the
beginning
of my career as number one!
